pla-01.prompt: Flat two-dimensional educational illustration. Simple closed shapes, clear dark outlines, completely solid uniform fills. No gradients, shading or texture. One complete adult speaker on left facing viewer extends open hand toward TWO MEN standing together on right farther away, the two men talking to each other and not looking at speaker. Red oval encloses ONLY the two men. THEY masculine plural. Flat solid fills dark outlines, whole people and oval, no labels. Single square CACE vocabulary image. Pure white background. Show every subject and essential prop whole inside the middle two thirds of the canvas. Zoom OUT, leave one sixth of canvas width empty at both sides, generous white above and below. Natural anatomically correct hands. Plain shoes and clothing. No border. Absolutely no text, writing, letters, numbers, labels, brand marks, emblems, logos or watermarks anywhere.
